# Amber

Type: Valuable | Internal ID: Amber | Source: Burial Chambers, , chests | Usage: Selling to a, Trader | Sell: 5, Coins | Teleportable (Can go through wood portal?): Yes

# Introduction

Amber is a Valuable item.

## Availability

• Stone Grave and Viking Graveyard in the Meadows
• Burial Chambers in the Black Forest
• Sunken Crypts in the Swamp
• Amber can be obtained from Fishing, as a bonus drop when catching Perch.

### Selling

• As a valuable, it can be sold to any of the traders for 5 Coins.
